## Summary and what was read

A developed normative programme: competition that selects survivors hands winners the rule, totalization is loss of independent capacity, so AI must not fight for any party. The account states some of the mechanism, conditionally and on models, under narrower words: agreement with a checked law's form holds for single mechanisms, not for the programme. Eight entries so agree, among them selection reaching only what couples into the selector, the lock belonging to how the rule reads and not what it favours, and, where an assistant's order rises with its principal's family, alignment to the principal alone not being alignment of the joint selection. Several further links are forms a law has, proposed here and not stated by the account, and live readings of the corpus's own meta-attractor count by descent, not as independent agreement. The programme asserts what the account only states conditionally or not at all: intelligence must be good; whatever continues 生生 is good; evil is owning a gate; generative centers hold standing; irreversible closure has priority; freedom is exit power; provenance gives the commons a claim; AI must not be a party; the current direction must stop. In the account no should stands beyond becoming: where it ranks such orderings, a result states the hypotheses its theorem takes, the continuation condition, self-concern or C, with J1 to J4 in 07 §5's scheme; T8 is a way of seeing offered for life, not a verdict. On its models it denies that "AI for all" is the only equilibrium and that changeability removes every plea, and it keeps a witness in which a closing pays every party.

<a id="cx-zhishan-variety-not-dying-alike"></a>
- **Variety, so that systems do not all die alike** (fresh-reading, agreement of a reading). [theories/zhishan-intelligence-must-be-good/README.md](../../../../zhishan-intelligence-must-be-good/README.md), Claims 184, 185, 252 (voice).
  - Its own sense: No system can be guaranteed against collapse, so the real invariant is keeping the sample space open: a variety of systems so that they do not all die from the same situational influence, foreseeable or not. Death is a feature; the aim is a rich space of systems, not one rule or attractor. 「so that they do not all die from the same situational influence」
  - Reading [AI reading]: Correlated failure has checked forms, on narrower objects. Reviewers moved under one cause fail together with all names kept, and a cause in no bound fails every reviewer, which is the source's 'foreseeable or not'. Copies add nothing. An ending reaches only what depends on the condition at the need, so unlike dependence escapes it. This read's join from reviewers to systems. No law ranks variety: that takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another.
